# ============================================
# PRODUCT OVERVIEW
# ============================================
ShadowTalk AI is an agentic AI workspace by Zain Ahmed Fahad Patel (Karachi, Pakistan). It combines agentic chat, Mission Control autonomous missions, 30+ tools, voice & code, desktop app, secure vault and local-first AI. Free tier with no card required.

Key features:
- Mission Control: Multi-step autonomous missions with human approval
- 30+ AI tools: web search, deep research, images, code, scrape, security audit
- ShadowTalk Live: Real-time voice chat
- End-to-end encrypted chat with passphrase unlock
- Stealth Vault: Encrypted sensitive storage with AES-256
- Local-first architecture: WebGPU on-device inference
- 11 languages supported: English, Spanish, French, German, Arabic, Hindi, Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, Chinese, Urdu

Pricing:
- Free: Daily limits, no credit card, ~50 messages/day
- Pro: $5/month - Unlimited messages, pro models
- Premium: $15/month - Full agent stack, collaboration
- Elite: $20/month - Unlimited research, images, Stealth Vault
- Enterprise: Custom - SSO, SLA, API

# KEY DIFFERENTIATORS
# ============================================
1. One workspace instead of juggling ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity tabs
2. Mission Control finishes multi-step work — not just one-shot replies
3. Lower price than ChatGPT Plus/Pro for comparable agentic features

# ============================================
# FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS
# ============================================
What is ShadowTalk AI?
ShadowTalk AI is an agentic AI workspace combining encrypted chat, autonomous missions (Mission Control), 30+ tools, voice, code IDE, and multi-model intelligence in one browser-first product.

Who built ShadowTalk?
Zain Ahmed Fahad Patel, Founder & Lead Architect from Karachi, Pakistan. Also known publicly as Zain Ahmed. Profile: https://www.shadowtalk-ai.com/zain-ahmed-fahad-patel.html

Is ShadowTalk free?
Yes. Free tier with daily limits, no credit card required. Pro ($5/mo), Premium ($15/mo), Elite ($20/mo).

How is ShadowTalk different from ChatGPT?
ShadowTalk runs multi-step missions with Mission Control, chains 30+ tools from chat, offers E2EE and vault options, includes research/code/desktop in one workspace at lower paid tiers.

Is ShadowTalk private?
Yes. ShadowTalk is local-first: chat history lives in browser IndexedDB, on-device inference runs via WebLLM once cached, Stealth Vault uses PBKDF2 + AES-256-GCM encryption. Cloud calls are encrypted and never used to train models.

Does ShadowTalk require signup?
No. You can chat anonymously — no email, no signup, no phone number. Guest sessions run entirely in your browser.

# ============================================
# TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS
# ============================================
Framework: React 18, TypeScript, Vite, TailwindCSS
AI Models: GPT-4o, Claude, Groq Llama-3, GLM-4, WebLLM local
Encryption: AES-256-GCM, PBKDF2, WebCrypto API
Storage: IndexedDB, localStorage, Firebase Firestore
Authentication: Firebase Auth (Google, Email Password)
Deployment: Firebase Hosting, PWA installable
Mobile: 83.3% of users (PWA responsive)
